li.label: trusted with the colony's finest
li.description: The council let me work the colony's finest material while the idea was still in my hands. It will be the best thing I ever made.

li.label: told the work comes first
li.description: I had it, the whole piece, and the council said the work comes first. It's going already.

li.label: given a little to steady me
li.description: They let me have some. The shaking stopped, and nobody said anything about it after.

li.label: kept from it
li.description: The council keeps it from me now. I know why. Knowing doesn't help at three in the morning.

li.label: good food left to rot
li.description: I brought it in, and it went rotten in the stores because nobody had the time to cook it.

li.label: the stores left in the rain
li.description: I carry those stores. The council would rather the rain had them than spare the time.

li.label: the old walls pulled down
li.description: Those walls stood longer than any of us will. Now they're building stone.

li.label: the old walls left standing
li.description: The council left the old walls as they stand. Some things should be older than us.

li.label: a room of my own at last
li.description: The council gave me the new room. A door that closes, and nobody snoring but me.

li.label: my study passed over
li.description: The council chose the other study. Mine will wait its turn, if it gets one.

li.label: left a hurt animal lying
li.description: It was lying there hurt, and the council said leave it to the wild. I keep looking out that way.

li.label: the ambrosia brought in
li.description: The colony picked the ambrosia and put it in the stores. Sweet, and it pulls at people. I'd have left it.

li.label: a clutch to raise
li.description: I found the eggs in the grass, and the colony is keeping them warm to see what hatches.
